newsitem.title: UK: BG sees MMC ruling on Ofgas plans in April.
newsitem.headline: BG sees MMC ruling on Ofgas plans in April.

text.p: BG Plc, the rump of the former British Gas Plc remaining after the demerger of its new Centrica Plc unit, said on Thursday it still believed that a long-awaited review of proposed gas transportation pricing rules would be published in April this year.

Industry regulator Ofgas suggested strict price controls on what BG could charge gas suppliers for transporting their gas last autumn but theses were rejected by British Gas as unfairly balanced, and the matter has been passed to the government's Monopolies and Mergers Commission for a ruling.

There has been market and industry speculation that the enquiry may not be completed until after the general election, which must be held in Britain before late May, but in its results statement BG stood by its expectation that the report would be handed over in April.
